title: Noncomputability of unary languages
statement: Let $S$ be a set of natural numbers whose membership predicate is not computable. The language of all-true Boolean lists whose lengths belong to $S$ also has no computable membership predicate.
hypotheses_covered: The set $S$ has a noncomputable membership predicate
